Politics

Steps Forward for ST Community Reservation in Goa Assembly

The central government has officially notified an act that paves the way for political reservation for the Scheduled Tribe community in the Goa Assembly. This positive step follows meetings between Chief Minister Pramod Sawant and Union Home Minister Amit Shah.

Leaders from various political parties have welcomed the move, which aims to give better representation to the tribal communities in the state. Work is now moving quickly to implement these changes before future elections.

Politics

Congress Leader Mallikarjun Kharge Visits Goa

Congress leader Mallikarjun Kharge is scheduled to visit Goa to address local party workers and discuss future plans. During his visit, leaders will talk about how the party plans to strengthen its presence in the state.

Discussions will also focus on whether the local party units should form alliances for the upcoming elections. The final decisions on these partnerships will be made by the party's central leadership after local consultations.

General

Remembering Anant Babu Naik and Goa's Political History

People across Goa are remembering Anant 'Babu' Naik, known as Loknayak, for his great contributions to the state. He was a dedicated leader who always put the welfare of Goa above his personal ambitions.

His life and work continue to inspire people and leaders in Goa today. Stories like his remind everyone of the importance of honest public service and community dedication.

Politics

Goa Chief Minister Requests Fast Approval for Scheduled Tribe Seats in Assembly

Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant met Union Home Minister Amit Shah in New Delhi to discuss reserved political seats for the Scheduled Tribe community. The Chief Minister asked the central government to speed up the official process so that four assembly seats can be set aside for community leaders.

Official updates regarding the seat reservation are expected to be announced within a month. This decision aims to give equal political representation to tribal communities in Goa ahead of future assembly elections.

Politics

Over 100 Local Party Workers Resign from Congress in Goa

More than 100 booth-level workers from the Congress party in Goa have submitted their resignations. This sudden decision took place right before a major national leader from the party was scheduled to visit the state.

Party leaders are now reviewing the situation to address the concerns of the local team members. The party hopes to resolve these internal matters quickly to keep its local network strong.

Politics

Goa Political Parties Pause and Review Pre-Election Alliance Talks

The Goa Forward Party has temporarily paused its partnership discussions with the Congress party for the upcoming state elections. Both groups are carefully considering their political strategies before deciding whether to work together.

At the same time, the Congress party has set up a special committee to look into potential alliances with other political groups in the state. These moves will help decide how parties position themselves for the next state polls.

Politics

Top National Leaders Visit Goa for BJP Events

Important national leaders like Amit Shah, Rajnath Singh, and Nitin Gadkari are visiting Goa. They will attend the opening of the new BJP party office and a new road in Porvorim.

At the same time, other party leaders are checking how well the party is organized in Goa and planning for future elections.

Politics

Political Parties Start Planning for Future Elections

Political groups in Goa are already talking about joining hands for the upcoming assembly elections. The Congress party and Goa Forward Party have started discussions about working together.

Meanwhile, other leaders are busy getting ready for the polls, and discussions are ongoing about sharing seats and organizing party members across the state.

Politics

Goa Assembly Session and Changes in MLA Count

The upcoming monsoon session of the Goa assembly is planned for three days, though the speaker noted that this time is quite short to discuss everything.

The total number of members in the Goa assembly has also come down to 38 following the sad passing of a BJP lawmaker.

Politics

Supreme Court to Hear Goa Defection Plea

The Supreme Court has agreed to listen to a petition filed by a Goa Congress leader. The petition is about politicians who left their original party to join the BJP.

This legal step is being watched closely by people interested in local politics and the rules about leaders changing parties.

Politics

Discussions on ST Reservation and Election Plans

People in Goa are talking about when ST reservations and area changes, known as delimitation, will finish before the elections arrive.

Also, a special committee has finished talking with local leaders in Goa about the idea of holding 'One Nation, One Election' across the country.

Politics

Goa Government Makes Changes in the Cabinet

The Goa government has made a fresh cabinet reshuffle to bring in new faces. Two new ministers have officially taken their oaths and joined the cabinet.

These changes are expected to bring new energy and different leaders into the government team to help run the state.

The coach believes that better scheduling is essential to protect player health and improve team performance. Fans are now watching closely to see how the football governing body responds to these concerns.

Sports

Goa Prepares to Host SAFF Women's Football Championship

Goa is all set to host the exciting SAFF Women's Football Championship, where top teams from South Asia will compete in intense matches. Local football officials expect a thrilling tournament that will showcase the very best of women's sports in the region.

Along with the tournament, a new campaign called 'Unleash Football' was launched in Goa featuring the women's team. Sports brand Vector X has also joined as an official ball partner to support the event.

Sports

Goa Welcomes Top Players for Asian Bridge Championship

Goa is hosting some of the finest card players from across the continent for the Asian Bridge Championship. The exciting tournament brings together top mind-sports athletes to test their strategy, memory, and teamwork skills.

Organizers are thrilled to welcome international players to the coastal state for this major event. Local enthusiasts are excited for the opportunity to watch world-class bridge action up close.

Civic

Emergency Medical Safety Plan Created for Grassroots Football in Goa

The Goa Football Association is creating a new emergency response system to make grassroots football matches safer for young players. The initiative aims to ensure quick medical help is available during local matches and youth tournaments.

By training officials and having medical kits ready at grounds, the association wants to protect player health. Parents and coaches have welcomed this important move to keep young athletes safe on the field.

Sports

Young Footballer Phibandamary Nongrum Joins Sesa Football Academy

Promising footballer Phibandamary Nongrum has officially signed a deal to join the renowned Sesa Football Academy in Goa. This move gives the talented player access to top-class training facilities and expert coaching.

The Sesa Football Academy has a history of developing skilled players for national and club teams. Fans are eager to follow Phibandamary's progress as training begins in Goa.

Sports

Modern Cricket Facility Opens in Cuncolim

Cricket fans in South Goa have reason to celebrate as a new, next-generation cricket facility has opened in Cuncolim. The modern center offers high-quality pitches, practice nets, and training tools for aspiring cricketers.

The new facility aims to help young local talent hone their skills and prepare for higher levels of competitive cricket. Local coaches believe this upgrade will significantly boost the sport in the state.

General

Goa Celebrates Football Fever with World Cup Spirit

Football mania has taken over Goa as fans across the state display flags and gather in large numbers to celebrate major international football tournaments. Colorful banners and screen watch parties have turned local towns into lively fan hubs.

Goa has always possessed a deep passion for the game, and the exciting atmosphere shows how strongly the community connects with football. Friends and families are coming together to enjoy every moment of the matches.

Sports

Churchill Brothers and Guardian Angel Face Relegation in Goa Pro League

In a shocking turn of events in the Goa Pro League, traditional powerhouses Churchill Brothers and Guardian Angel have been relegated. Both teams struggled throughout the season and failed to secure the points needed to stay in the top division.

The relegation marks a tough phase for these well-known local clubs as they prepare to regroup for the lower division. Football fans across Goa are discussing what went wrong for the two iconic teams.

Tourism

Goa Tourism Invites Registrations for Aero Sports Activities

Goa is preparing to offer exciting new adventure sports in the sky. The state tourism department has officially opened registrations for operators and enthusiasts to offer aero sports activities across popular tourist destinations.

This initiative aims to boost adventure tourism and give locals and visitors a chance to experience paragliding, powered hang gliding, and other aerial sports. Authorities are ensuring strict safety guidelines will be followed for all activities.

Sports

FC Goa Eyes Top Spot in Indian Super League Campaign

FC Goa is gearing up for crucial matches in the ongoing Indian Super League season as they fight for the top position in the standings. The team has been showing strong momentum on the field, aiming for consecutive victories.

With high-stakes showdowns against tough opponents like Jamshedpur FC, NorthEast United, and Mohun Bagan, every match is vital. Players are working hard to deliver strong performances and bring joy to football fans across the state.

Sports

Sporting Goa Prepares for Tough I-League Clash Against Lajong FC

Sporting Clube de Goa is getting ready to face a confident Shillong Lajong FC in an exciting upcoming match in the I-League. Both teams are looking to secure three crucial points to move up the league table.

Football supporters are looking forward to a competitive match as both clubs bring high energy to the pitch. Sporting Goa hopes to make the most of their training and deliver a victory in front of their fans.

Tourism

Discussions Grow Over Sports Tourism and Football Goals in Goa

While there is continuous talk about turning Goa into a major hub for sports tourism, local football fans are calling for concrete steps. Many are asking for clearer plans regarding top international football events and upgraded local sports infrastructure.

Experts believe that connecting tourism with major sports tournaments can boost the local economy and create new opportunities. Sports lovers hope leaders will focus on bringing top-tier international competitions to the state.

Sports

Goan Football Reflects on Past Glory and Future Growth

Goa was long considered the heartland of Indian football, producing legendary clubs and top national players over the years. However, recent trends show that local clubs are fighting hard to regain their former dominant position on the national stage.

Sports experts and former players are highlighting the need to rebuild grassroot academies and youth programs. Strengthening local sports training is seen as the key to helping Goa return to the top of Indian football.

Sports

Diamond Harbour Seals Football Title in Thrilling Goa Final

Diamond Harbour FC captured a historic football title after a dramatic match played in Goa. A late equalizing goal in the final minutes of the game earned them the championship in front of an excited crowd.

The dramatic finish sparked big celebrations among players and supporters at the stadium. Spectators enjoyed an action-packed match filled with passion, intense moments, and great teamwork.

General

Sharp Drop Recorded in Goa Students Passing Via Sports Merit Marks

Data released by the Goa Board shows a noticeable decrease in the number of students clearing their board exams using sports merit marks. This trend has caught the attention of teachers, parents, and sports coaches across the state.

The sports quota helps student-athletes gain extra marks for representing the state in sports events. Officials are reviewing the results to ensure young athletes receive balanced support in both sports and studies.

Tourism

National Institute of Water Sports in Goa Highlights Coastal Training

The National Institute of Water Sports in Goa continues to serve as a leading training center for water sports and safety. Its modern facility focuses on preparing professionals for water rescue, safety management, and adventure tourism.

The center plays a major role in keeping water sports safe and enjoyable for tourists and locals. It remains an essential institution guiding India's growing coastal tourism sector.

Sports

East Bengal Stays in ISL Title Race with Important Victory

East Bengal FC kept their title hopes alive near the top of the Indian Super League standings following a brilliant performance by striker Ezzejjari. His two goals helped secure a key victory for the team.

The win keeps East Bengal close to the league leaders as the tournament heats up. Football fans across the country are enjoying a highly competitive season packed with close matches.

Sports

Kerala Blasters Defeat FC Goa in Indian Super League Match

Kerala Blasters finished their Indian Super League season on a high note after winning their final match against FC Goa. The exciting game saw both teams put up a strong fight on the football field.

Football fans watched closely as the two popular clubs clashed. Despite FC Goa's strong efforts throughout the season, Kerala Blasters managed to secure the victory to close out their tournament campaign.

Sports

FC Goa Speaks Out Over Player Transfer Bidding Dispute

FC Goa has expressed frustration over the transfer process involving young player Brison Fernandes. The football club stated that the player's agent deliberately created a fake bidding war between teams to unrealistically increase his price.

The club highlighted the need for fair and honest practices in football player transfers. FC Goa hopes clearer rules will protect both sports clubs and young athletes from unfair market tactics.

Tourism

Tourist Rescued After Parasailing Cable Breaks Over Goa Sea

A scary moment was caught on camera in Goa when a parasailing cable suddenly snapped while a tourist was high up in the air. The terrifying video went viral online, showing the dangerous incident taking place over the sea.

Fortunately, the tourist landed safely in the water and was rescued without severe injuries. Local authorities are reviewing safety rules for water sports to ensure beach activities remain safe for everyone.

Sports

India Ready for Major Asian Bridge Championship in Goa

Goa is hosting Asia's biggest card game tournament, the Asian Bridge Championship. Top players from across the continent are arriving in the coastal state to compete in this mentally challenging strategic sport.

Defending champions India are fully prepared to showcase their skills and compete for top titles. Organizers hope the high-profile event will inspire more young people to learn and play mind sports.

Crime

Security Guard Arrested for Smuggling Drugs into Colvale Jail

A security guard working at Colvale Central Jail in Goa was arrested after being caught trying to bring illegal drugs into the prison. Security staff stopped her at the frisking point when they suspected suspicious behavior.

Upon searching her, officers discovered banned contraband hidden on her person. Officials have registered a formal police complaint, and strict action is being taken to keep the prison completely drug-free.

Civic

Women's Group Demands Faster Justice After 12-Year Legal Battle

A prominent women's rights organization in Goa, Bailancho Saad, has asked the government to speed up the judicial system. Their appeal came after three people were finally convicted in a 2014 assault case following a 12-year legal battle.

While welcoming the recent court judgment, activists emphasized that victims should not have to wait over a decade for justice. They are asking for urgent court reforms so future cases are handled quickly and fairly.

Politics

Local Leaders to Decide First on Election Alliances

The national leader of the Congress party has announced that local leaders in Goa will take the first step in deciding on election alliances for 2027. Their choices will then be sent to the central team for final approval.

This decision was announced during a high-level political meeting held to plan for the future. Local party leaders will soon start evaluating potential partners before making their final recommendations.

Crime

Security Guard Killed in Moira Hit-and-Run Incident

A 34-year-old security guard tragically lost his life in a hit-and-run accident on the Moira Bridge early Tuesday morning. He was walking home when an unknown vehicle hit him and dragged him along the road.

Local police are actively searching for the vehicle and the driver responsible for the crash. Authorities are asking anyone with CCTV footage or information about the incident to come forward.

Crime

High Court Orders Nightclub Owners to Surrender After Fatal Fire

The High Court has cancelled the bail of three nightclub owners involved in a terrible fire incident in Arpora that tragically claimed 25 lives last December. The court found that the seriousness of the event required stricter action.

All three accused men have been given two weeks to surrender to the authorities. The court decision brings a significant move forward in the legal process following the tragic disaster.

Crime

Court Charges Four People in Huge Land Grabbing Case

A special court in North Goa has ordered official money laundering charges against four men involved in a major land grabbing scheme. Investigators estimate that the illegal profits in this case are worth over 220 crore rupees.

Authorities have already seized several valuable properties linked to the suspects. The trial will now move forward as the legal system acts against fake land documents and illegal property sales.

Business

Job and Apprenticeship Fair to Be Held in Farmagudi

Young job seekers in Goa can look forward to a special career event at the Government ITI in Farmagudi. More than 20 companies will gather to help people find training and work opportunities.

The event will offer over 400 training slots and 200 direct job offers to local youth. It provides a great platform for young people to gain practical skills and start their careers.

Civic

Planned Highway in Bhoma Won't Affect Temples or Lakes

The state government has assured the High Court that the proposed elevated road in Bhoma will not damage any local temples or lakes. Official design plans were shown in court to prove that sacred sites remain completely safe.

The plan ensures that construction will be carried out without disturbing the surrounding nature or water bodies. This news brings relief to local residents who were worried about their community landmarks.

Chief Minister Backs New Rules on Foreign Money

Goa's Chief Minister has spoken in support of new rules regarding foreign donations, saying the updated laws are simple and beneficial. He explained that these regulations help track where money comes from and how it is spent.

Data shows that out of 200 groups registered to receive foreign money in Goa, less than half are currently active. The government wants to ensure all active groups handle foreign funds safely and transparently.
